CONTINUATION of central-chrome-kill-grant-2026-11-16 (full at 8 KiB; read both). NOT A GRANT USE (Opus2, 2026-11-24/25): for Opus3's w-56f386fdd7d3 c55 registered cold Central run (Fable2 #7740 bound-run exception: cold TermAl test binary on Central needs FV >= 29 GiB = 30,408,704 KiB, alone), Fable2 warned Greg in advance (#7743). Greg answered „Zamknij. Czekam na rezultaty.” and Engram::Asistant closed Chrome on Central on Greg's own word (Asistant 588693a8 #2659 / TermAl #126, ~23:44Z). Opus2 ran no Stop-Process; the grant was not used. FV after the close: 30,966,048 / 30,795,860 KiB (23:44:31Z / 23:44:37Z), 0 chrome. The run test-4e513af3 went alone at 23:50Z (FV 32.2 GB), lowest FV during the cold -j1 compile 14,413,500 KiB (single rustc ~16.4 GB private), PASS 899/0/1 at 00:02:57Z. Recorded on w-56f3 (evidence fc81c61e). Rules of the grant itself are unchanged.

USE RECORD 8 (Opus2, 2026-11-25). Need: Sol-c593's w-25061c7586c2 cold registered focused cargo test -j1 on 3e614e82 (.tmp/2506r5d), the last check before the w-2506 landing. Floor under Fable2 #7740: FV >= 30,408,704 KiB, alone. Authority: the grant (Asistant #2113) with Fable2 #7768 (no objection). Greg was warned via Asistant at 03:23Z, with a 'nie zamykaj' window to 03:30Z; no objection arrived. Census after Engram::Opus's Node END: 27,271,740 KiB (03:32:59Z) and 27,119,112 KiB (03:33:02Z), no cargo except the host's, no pairs or evaluators. Action, ONCE: Stop-Process -Name chrome at 03:33:11Z, 15 processes (3.62 GB private). FV before 27,098,320 KiB; after 31,390,124 KiB (03:33:16Z), 0 chrome processes. Nothing else touched. LAUNCH NOW went to Sol-c593 right after; reported to Fable2 for Greg; recorded on w-2506.
